title: Google Flights Scraper Input
description: Enter flight search details. The system accepts multiple date formats (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY) and flexible field names.

origin.title: Origin Airport
origin.description: The 3-letter IATA code for the origin airport (e.g., 'YVR').

destination.title: Destination Airport
destination.description: The 3-letter IATA code for the destination airport (e.g., 'NRT').

departure_date.title: Departure Date
departure_date.description: The departure date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, or MM/DD/YYYY.

return_date.title: Return Date
return_date.description: The return date for a round trip. Leave empty for a one-way trip.

seat.title: Cabin Class
seat.description: Can also use the field name 'cabin_class'.

fixed_flights.title: Fixed Flights (Advanced)
fixed_flights.description: For multi-city or specific flight routes. Specify outbound and/or return flight segments.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: If true, the browser will be visible during the run. Useful for debugging.

only_direct_airline_booking.title: Only Airline Direct Booking
only_direct_airline_booking.description: If true, only direct booking options from the airline will be returned.

max_results.title: Maximum Results
max_results.description: The maximum number of flight combinations to return. Set to 0 for no limit.

max_outbound_flight_limit.title: Max Outbound Flight Limit
max_outbound_flight_limit.description: Limit the number of outbound flights processed to reduce crawling. Set to 0 for no limit.

max_return_flight_limit.title: Max Return Flight Limit
max_return_flight_limit.description: Limit the number of return flights processed (per outbound flight) to reduce crawling. Set to 0 for no limit.

max_crawler_runtime_secs.title: Max Crawler Runtime (Seconds)
max_crawler_runtime_secs.description: The maximum time allowed for a single browser fetch operation. Default is 60 seconds.
